title: Choosing Your First Airsoft Rifle
excerpt: A comprehensive guide for beginners on how to select their first AEG rifle, covering budget, performance, and reliability.
content:
# Choosing Your First Airsoft Rifle

Starting your airsoft journey can be overwhelming with so many options available. The most important decision you'll make is your first primary weapon...

## 1. Budget
Don't just look at the price of the gun. Remember to budget for batteries, chargers, and safety gear.

## 2. Platform
While M4 and AK platforms are the most common, choose something that feels comfortable in your hands.

## 3. Performance
Look for a rifle with a reliable gearbox and decent out-of-the-box accuracy.

# TX-15 Carbine: In-Depth Review

The TX-15 from Lone Star Armory has been making waves in the airsoft community. We spent a month testing its limits...

## Build Quality
The full metal construction feels incredibly solid. No wobble in the handguard or stock.

## Performance
With a consistent 400 FPS, this rifle is a beast on the field. The trigger response is crisp thanks to the high-torque motor.

title: Maintenance Tips for Gas Blowback Pistols
excerpt: Learn how to keep your GBB pistol running smoothly with these essential maintenance tips.
content:
# Maintenance Tips for Gas Blowback Pistols

Gas blowback pistols like the Glock 17 require regular maintenance to ensure longevity and performance...

## Cleaning
Always clean the inner barrel after every game day to prevent dust buildup.

## Lubrication
Use high-quality silicone oil on the slide rails and O-rings. Avoid petroleum-based lubricants as they can damage the rubber seals.
